title: French Tour of the Skywalk Grand Canyon and Hoover Dam
includes: Grand Canyon West Park entrance and Skywalk option
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 5 years of age cannot participate
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Come and discover the Grand Canyon in a small group and in French! 

We can accommodate up to 6 people per vehicle. We adapt to everyone and make sure to make your visit unforgettable.

Francophone guide, passionate about the American West, we take you in the footsteps of the Amerindians and this mythical place.
- Transport from your hotel
- Morning snack as well as lunch picnic provided as well as drinks
- Stops according to your desires

You'll explore Grand Canyon West's must-see landmarks such as Eagle Point, Guano Point and Skywalk. 
On the way back, we will make a photo stop on the Mike O’Callaghan–Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge with stunning views of Hoover Dam.
Then you will return to Las Vegas directly to your hotel. 
Don't worry about the organization, we'll take care of everything!
